subject: Prioritization matrix for Q4 infra/platform hires
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prioritization matrix for Q4 infra/platform hires

Team —

I'm attaching a working prioritization matrix for the Q4 hiring slate (attached: 2026_q4_platform_hiring_matrix.xlsx). We have an ask for four additional FTEs in the runtime/infra surface to close a few urgent gaps:

- 2x Runtime Engineers (inference performance focus)
- 1x Infra SRE (oncall + reliability)
- 1x Platform Engineer (dedicated capacity and deployment automation)

High-level constraints: budgeted hiring headroom is limited; finance prefers staged commitments and we need to demonstrate expected throughput/latency improvements per hire. Please review and:

1) Score roles with the attached matrix (impact, time-to-impact, cost) and propose a prioritized order.
2) Confirm recommended comp bands for each headcount (Monica, adding you to confirm ranges).
3) Recommend whether we reallocate an existing open slot from the Dedicated team or request net-new (Laura — we may need a one-time exception).

Target: finalize ordering and approvals this week so Recruiting can open reqs. I've flagged two external partners (CloudOps) who could accelerate onboarding if we prioritize platform automation work.

Notes in the spreadsheet: a conservative estimate is $450k incremental run-rate if we hire all four at mid bands; aggressive case (two L5s) is ~$600k.

Thanks — please reply inline with short bullets.

—Marcus Lin
Senior Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference
attachments: [2026_q4_platform_hiring_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 72KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prioritization matrix for Q4 infra/platform hires

Thanks Marcus — looked through the matrix. Quick thoughts:

- Scoring: please add a "service disruption risk" column and weight it higher for SRE work. That will push the SRE to the top for near-term priority.
- Role allocation: propose 1 Runtime SWE (high perf) + 1 SRE immediate hires; hold the second runtime until we see onboarding impact (6–8 weeks). Platform engineer can be a mid-Q4 hire.
- Comp bands (prelim): Runtime L4: $165k–$195k; Runtime L5: $215k–$250k; SRE L4: $160k–$190k; Platform L4: $150k–$180k. Monica, confirm final bands and whether signing bonuses are permitted for Q4.

Recruiting note: our pipeline currently has two strong Runtime L4 candidates (pipeline IDs in Hiring -> Runtime 2026). If we greenlight one slot now we can convert quickly.

Subject: Re: Prioritization matrix for Q4 infra/platform hires

+1 to Karthik's risk-weighting recommendation. A few operational points:

- Oncall load: include a normalized oncall-hours metric in the matrix (SRE will materially reduce mean-time-to-recovery for the inference fleet). That will justify moving SRE up even if immediate revenue impact is small.
- Phasing: recommend we split the Runtime hires into L4 + L5 so we get breadth (one strong IC + one growth hire). That keeps the headcount cost moderate while improving throughput.
- Vendor support: CloudOps (Jenna) can help with the initial automation for VPC/private deployment; if we buy a 3-month engagement it reduces platform hire ramp time — cost estimate in the matrix notes.

Attachment: short candidate profile template included in the sheet.

Grace

Folks —

Confirmed comp band guidance attached (comp_bands_q3_2026.pdf). Summary ranges (total comp):

- L4 individual contributor: $150k–$195k
- L5 senior IC: $200k–$255k
- Signing bonus: we can approve up to $15k for critical hires on a case-by-case basis (requires business case).

Budget note: People Ops can approve up to two L5 hires in Q4 without additional headcount delegation; anything above that requires Finance/Exec approval. Please submit an Offer Approval Form (attached) and a headcount request in HR (link below). Provide job codes and expected FTE start dates.

HR headcount request: https://redwood.company/hr/headcount-request/HL-7283
Attachments: comp_bands_q3_2026.pdf, Offer_Approval_Form.docx

—Monica Patel

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Prioritization matrix for Q4 infra/platform hires

Thanks all for the fast turnaround. Approved conditional on the following:

1) Immediate approval for 3 hires only: 1x Infra SRE + 2x Runtime Engineers (one L4, one L5). Recruiter: open reqs and mark hires as committed spend for Q4.
2) The 4th role (Platform Engineer) needs a short cost/benefit summary routed to Finance (expected cost vs savings in infra ops) before exec sign-off; route via the HL-7283 headcount request.
3) Include an expected latency/throughput delta tied to each hire in the updated matrix. I want concrete KPIs we can measure at 6 and 12 weeks.

Marcus — update the spreadsheet with the oncall weighting and the phased start dates. Once you and Karthik update, Monica/Recruiting should file the offer approval forms and we can get People Ops to issue the reqs. If Finance flags the fourth hire, we'll decide whether to convert one of the planned L4s into a contractor bridge.

Laura Bennett
VP, Platform & Infra
Redwood Inference
